title: Teodoro says cyberspace is a new domain of conflict

blocks.text: MANILA – Department of National Defense (DND) Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Thursday said advances in digital technology have made cyberspace an increasingly established domain of conflict. “We have witnessed increasingly that the cyber domain, (also known as the) digital domain, is another (fully) mature area of conflict,” he said during the closing ceremonies of this year’s “DAGIT-PA” drills in Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City. Teodoro noted that with advances in this particular field, traditional areas of conflict like the sea, air and land are now being left behind.
